title: TRACE：面向多目标材料发现的转换感知残差控制框架
summary: TRACE框架将评估编辑作为反馈基本单元，记录父子编辑转换及属性变化，聚合证据估计可复用编辑效果，排序未来编辑以减少约束违规并避免损害已满足目标。在相同骨干对比中，宏平均命中率从18.13%提升至25.96%。
summary_en: TRACE treats evaluated edits as feedback units, records parent-edit-child transitions with property deltas, aggregates evidence to estimate reusable edit effects, and ranks edits to reduce constraint violations. It improves macro-average hit rate from 18.13% to 25.96% over LLEMA.
